cv:
Martina Benítez · Software engineer · Montevideo, Uruguay
Health-tech company (2021 – present, 5 years): clinical-note coding assistant with LLMs, Python, FastAPI.
reply:
Hi Sofia,

1) I built a coding assistant that suggests billing codes from clinical notes. About 45 medical coders use it every day, and it cut the time per note by roughly 40%. I designed the extraction prompts, the review screen and the fallback that sends low-confidence notes to a senior coder.
2) We keep 250 notes coded by senior coders as a test set and run it on every change. Exact-match accuracy went from 74% to 89%, and we also track how often coders override a suggestion.
3) Notes that mention a condition only to rule it out. We added a negation step before coding, which removed most false positives.
4) Code lookups against the official catalog are plain database queries; the model only proposes candidates from the note text.
5) Montevideo, Uruguay. $37/h. English 8/10. 7 hours of overlap with US Eastern.

Best,
Martina
